Keating Investment Counselors Inc increased its stake in Verizon Communications Inc (VZ) by 13.33% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Keating Investment Counselors Inc bought 19,291 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 164,050 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.85 million, up from 144,759 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Keating Investment Counselors Inc who had been investing in Verizon Communications Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $203.08B market cap company. The stock increased 1.53% or $0.74 during the last trading session, reaching $49.15. About 4.95M shares traded. Verizon Communications Inc. (NYSE:VZ) has risen 7.08% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.49% the S&P500.
